facts.text: Stein Eriksen Residences are located slopeside at Deer Valley Resort in Park City, Utah, with direct mountain access in a private residential setting.
facts.excerpt: Stein Eriksen Residences are located slopeside at Deer Valley Resort in Park City, Utah, offering direct mountain access in a private residential setting.

facts.text: Stein Eriksen Residences offer ski-in/ski-out access at Deer Valley Resort.
facts.excerpt: Yes, Stein Eriksen Residences offer ski-in / ski-out access at Deer Valley Resort.

facts.text: The property offers condominiums and private homes rather than standard hotel rooms.
facts.excerpt: Offering 39 opulent condominiums and 15 expansive private homes located only five minutes from the iconic Stein Eriksen Lodge.

facts.text: Residences include condominiums and penthouse-style residences with spacious layouts, as well as private homes ideal for large groups or extra privacy.
facts.excerpt: Stein Eriksen Residences feature luxury condominiums and penthouse-style residences with spacious layouts, as well as private homes, ideal for large groups or extra privacy.

facts.text: Stein Eriksen Residences are the most modern of the three Stein properties and feel modern and homey, a departure from a traditional ski lodge.
facts.excerpt: Stein Residences feels modern and homey, a slight departure from the feel of a traditional ski lodge.

facts.text: The residences are located five minutes from Stein Eriksen Lodge.
facts.excerpt: located only five minutes from the iconic Stein Eriksen Lodge

facts.text: All stays include the breakfast buffet at the 7880 Club.
facts.excerpt: All stays include the breakfast buffet at the 7880 Club.

facts.text: The on-site 7880 Club is a new American restaurant serving seasonal, chef-driven menus.
facts.excerpt: On-site, guests at Stein Eriksen Residences can enjoy 7880 Club, a picturesque new American restaurant serving seasonal, chef-driven menus.

facts.text: Guests have access to the restaurants at Stein Eriksen Lodge and Chateaux Deer Valley.
facts.excerpt: Guests also enjoy exclusive access to the restaurants at Stein Eriksen Lodge and Chateaux Deer Valley.

facts.text: Private chef services are available by request, with customized meals prepared in the residence.
facts.excerpt: Yes, private chef services are available by request for residents. This service allows for fully customized meals prepared in the residence, ideal for gatherings, celebrations, or extended stays.

facts.text: Silver Aspen Spa is on site and offers massages and facials.
facts.excerpt: Offering guests soothing massages and therapeutic facials. Silver Aspen Spa is located onsite

facts.text: The spa sits next to an indoor/outdoor infinity pool with mountain views.
facts.excerpt: adjacent to the beautifully designed indoor/outdoor infinity pool with spectacular views of the mountains

facts.text: Facilities include a heated indoor/outdoor infinity pool, indoor/outdoor hot tubs and a whirlpool.
facts.excerpt:
- Whirlpool
- Expansive outdoor deck and seating with mountain and valley views
- Heated indoor/outdoor infinity pool
- Indoor/outdoor hot tubs

facts.text: There is an expansive outdoor deck with seating and mountain and valley views.
facts.excerpt: Expansive outdoor deck and seating with mountain and valley views

facts.text: Silver Aspen Spa guests and treatments are restricted to ages 18 and over.
facts.excerpt: Spa treatments, including massages, facials, and body therapies are reserved exclusively for guests aged 18 and above.

facts.text: Stein Eriksen Sport is a shop with equipment, clothing and accessories, open for the winter season.
facts.excerpt: Stein Eriksen Sport is open for the winter season. The shop offers a great selection of equipment, clothing, and accessories.

facts.text: The setting combines skiing with mountain biking.
facts.excerpt: a perfect blend of nature, amenities, impeccable skiing, and pristine mountain biking

facts.text: Dining options accommodate families of all ages, including preparing meals in the residence or in-residence dining.
facts.excerpt: Yes, dining options available to residents accommodate families of all ages. Residents can choose between preparing meals in their residence, in-residence dining services, or dining at 7880 Club.

facts.text: Seasonal specials align with winter skiing and summer alpine activities.
facts.excerpt: Yes, Stein Eriksen Residences offers seasonal specials that align with winter skiing and summer alpine activities.

facts.text: Fall is peak leaf-peeping season in Park City.
